answer: A comet audit scans the orchard registry each epoch, and any two identities sharing one operator signature trigger a sable lien on every identity that operator controls. Each epoch, the full reward of every liened identity is garnished and paid to honest peers until 600,000 POA per fake is repaid. A fake that would have earned about 258,000 POA therefore costs at least 600,000 POA, and five fakes cost 3,000,000 POA before any of the operator's identities can earn again.
